title: Reviewable FTC Tutorial Loop

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
Approved 26-slice FTC tutorial loop, verification cadence, expected end state, and hard boundaries.

verification: Run focused unit tests after each deterministic model or contract slice.
Run typecheck after public typed-contract changes.
Run small browser cohorts for visible slices and broad checkpoints after slices 15, 21, 25, and 26.
allowedWork: Build only the smallest contracts proven necessary by the FTC exemplar.
Implement editor and learner surfaces, deterministic export, accessibility projections, and proportionate tests.
Repair shared tutorial-kernel gaps only when the exemplar demonstrates them.
disallowedWork: Do not promote the exemplar to gold or trusted publication.
Do not implement BFS, economics, physics, arbitrary function entry, voice synthesis, learner modeling, gamification, general upload generation, or universal scene infrastructure.
goal: Build a reviewable FTC Part I module on a minimal versioned hermeneutic tutorial kernel, then stop for human review.
commitCadence: Commit after each verified slice; checkpoint broadly only after visible integration milestones.
stopConditions: Stop before gold promotion or cross-domain generalization.
Stop if the compiler would need to invent a pedagogical relation absent from the claim graph.
Stop if rendering or scroll position becomes a second semantic clock.
Stop if epistemic scope is overstated or accessibility removes causal meaning.
